summary: This document updates the Protection State Coordination logic for MPLS-TP linear protection from RFC 6378. It adds rules and recommendations for using TLVs, addresses issues raised in an ITU-T liaison statement, and clarifies behavior in a case RFC 6378 did not explain well.

eli5.summary: If a road is blocked, traffic switches to a backup road, and both ends must agree on when. This RFC fixes some gaps in the rules that tell two ends of a network path how to switch together.
